about_the_game:
This demo provides a taste of the Space Fishing lifestyle. Get a feel for your space rod and catch a curated selection of Space Fish including 2 legendary space fish with unique abilities to test your reeling skills.

Included in this Demo:

  • 8 Catchable Space Fish Species

  • Progress through the first 4 Space Fishing Guild Missions.

  • Customise your Space Rod with a limited selection of parts, including changing your line colour.

  • Decorate your asteroid with a limited selection of placeable items and decorations.

The rush is on since the discovery of space fish. With your trusty Space Rod in hand, reel in unique and fun space fish with their own reeling characteristics, such as the Galactic Goldfish and Cometuna. Sell your catches off in shipments and bundle them right for bonuses! Upgrade your gear with the modular rod system to handle different fish or find your perfect balance.

Rise the ranks of the Galactic Union of Interstellar Line Danglers (or GUILD) to unlock more gear, shipping perks and equipment to help you find tougher and more valuable fish, including legendary space fish with unique abilities that will test your reeling skills.

Reel in Space Fish

Your space rod is fitted with the GUILDs patented Reelscope technology to help pull in your catch. Each fish breed has its own reeling traits, and every catch is unique.

 

Selling Fish

Fish and Shipping go fin-in-fin. Package up your catches to send them off to the GUILD, each shipment has unique perks to meet the demand of these stellar snac...uh, specimens.

 

Buying Gear

The trusty Space Rod is highly customisable, unlock and purchase rod parts, baits, hooks and more that can alter the characteristics and feel when reeling in Space Fish. After all what is a fisher without a range of highly customisable equipment when a stick and few kilometres of some basic laser line would do the trick.

 

Legendary Fish

Lookout for legendary space fish with their own unique abilities to stir up a swell. The GUILD are heavily interested in these elusive fish and will pay quite the credit if you can land them.

 

Making it your home

The GUILDs travel contract doesn’t mention a return date, so may as well get comfortable on your new home. Spend your earnings one structures, decorations, spaceable plants, lighting, and of course, space chairs.

Features:

·         Cast your line out any direction to fish

·         Reel in Fish with the Reelscope Rod attachment

·         Catch a range of unique fish with their own reeling characteristics

·         A modular system for customising your space rod

·         A placement system for making the asteroid your home

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2000 series or RX 6000 series or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Hex-core Intel or AMD, 3.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: RTX 3070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 MB available space

short_description: Cast your line from your cozy asteroid home and reel in Space Fish, each with their own unique feel! Sell catches, upgrade gear, and tackle legendary fish with unique challenges when reeling them in. And customize your asteroid! Because nothing says “Gone Space Fishin” like a well-furnished rock.
